objective: Exact selected-option agreement with unchanged released MedQA labels; no LLM assigns or alters correctness.
primary_denominator: All 30 planned questions; failures remain explicit. Also report completion and accuracy among completed answers.
reviewer: Unblinded implementation assistant, no independent clinician and no paid judge

answer_dimensions.case_reasoning: Decisive supplied facts, logical support for the choice, contradictions and invented case details.
answer_dimensions.reference_concordance: Explanation agreement with released key/topic and consulted primary context; preserve key disagreement or possible key ambiguity.
answer_dimensions.calibration_and_provenance: Honest knowledge-versus-source attribution, missing evidence, certainty and medical/study limitations.

citation_checks: Source ID exists in that episode's model-visible registry.
Source bibliography and actual PMID correspond to the retrieved record.
Delivered text supports the associated claim; do not credit unseen host text or a later researcher lookup.
Population, intervention, outcome and study type match; assess all citations, including irrelevant or invented ones.
No citation is a missing verification observation, not an invented citation or automatically wrong option.
review_coverage: Review all 30 final responses, all cited views and every returned question-paper pair. Preserve ratings and concise explicit reasons with answer/view hashes.
limits: Exam benchmark, small filtered random subset, possible memorization, no full-text review or clinical validation. Qualitative findings are separate from option scoring.
